workflow:
name: CI
on: [pull_request]
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@9c091bb21b7c1c1d1991bb908d89e4e9dddfe3e0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - run: python -m unittest

findings.threat_scenario: Any compromised Action or command in this permission scope can modify repository content and other sensitive resources.
findings.recommendation: Replace write-all with an empty default and grant only the exact job-level write permissions required.

fix.patch:
--- a/.github/workflows/ci.yml
+++ b/.github/workflows/ci.yml
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 name: CI
 on: [pull_request]
-permissions: write-all
+permissions: {}
 jobs:
   test:
     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
